item.title: Palantir CEO Alex Karp Declares War on AI Labs as Q2 Growth Soars 93%
item.summary: Palantir's Q2 2026 results reveal 93% growth, a bold AI sovereignty strategy, and how its customer-first approach is reshaping enterprise AI. The post Palantir CEO Alex Karp Declares War on AI Labs as Q2 Growth Soars 93% appeared first on Cloud Wars .
